scope: Read-only essential source review. Owner fixture receipts are bound and distinguished from independent static inspection. No whole-population journal, new numeric reference, image query, fitting or scoring was executed by this review.

Every ordered238 prediction must contain nine arms before final prediction seal; worker failure preserves an unsealed failure receipt.

Large predictions stream once into small metric-only inputs; complete ordered238 and all arms are validated before numeric reference access.

All46 CAL,49 TEST and143 remainder rows/fallbacks remain; thresholds, distribution functions and unresolved-rotation handling match parent APIs.
CAL Gaussian prior remains unbounded and coarse-correlated; containment is a conditional soft shape cue, not calibrated hidden-point evidence.
No source review claim of pose improvement, global optimality, physical uniqueness, default adoption or goal completion is made.
limits: Runtime numerical outcomes and the forthcoming independent whole238 audit are not asserted by this source review.
